title: Application — transparent conductive films
description: Reference application record. Silver nanowire meshes and graphene are studied as replacements for brittle indium tin oxide. The nanoscale runs 1–100 nm; a nanometer is a billionth of a meter — about 100,000 times smaller than a human hair’s width.
